snippet.title: Spires of Morosith | TRAILER (Original)
snippet.description:
In Spires of Morosith you command gatherers to harvest from the forest and summon defensive towers to protect the Kingdom and heal the sundered Gossamer.

WISHLIST: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094970/Spires_of_Morosith/
